title: syed ka qoon haye bahate hai ashqiya
body:
syed ka qoon haaye bahate hai ashqiya
marqad me sayyada ko rulate hai asqiya
koofe ke haal dekhiye ya murtaza ali
muslim ko baam par se giraate hai asqiya
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan me touq daal ke ibne aqeel ko
zanjeere qaardaar pinhaate hai ashqiya
be jurmo be gunah ke laashe ko haye haye
koocha ba koocha le ke phiraate hai asqiya
<<DIVIDER>>
*hilmi* ye kalmagoh hai musalmaa'n hai sab ke sab
muslim ka jo ke qoon bahaate hai ashqiya
